whenToUse: Primary app navigation with sections, submenus, flyouts and a collapsible rail.
Used inside App shell; dark in both themes.
avoidWhen: Websites — use Navbar or Navigation Menu.
In-page section navigation — use Tabs or the Settings nav.
a11y: A labelled nav; the active link has aria-current=page.
Rail mode keeps labels via tooltips and accessible names.
